Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
As part of the Mobile Tribe , we are responsible for the Private Bank's mobile application portfolio in the German market. To further strengthen our capabilities within the tribe, we are establishing a new squad focused on advancing our mobile white-label platform and driving excellence in quality assurance.
 We are looking for a highly motivated Senior QA Engineer who combines strong manual testing expertise with advanced automation skills. In this role, you will work closely with Product Owners, Designers, Developers, and QA Engineers throughout the entire software development lifecycle to ensure the delivery of high-quality mobile banking solutions across both iOS and Android platforms .
 You will play a key role in validating new features, implementing automated test coverage, improving our QA processes, driving accessibility testing, and contributing to the evolution of our existing automation framework.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Quality Assurance & Test Management 
Own end-to-end quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle.
Perform Test Analysis, Test Planning, Test Case Design, Test Execution and Test Reporting.
Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation aligned with business requirements and user stories.
Manage test execution and defect tracking using Jira.
Execute full test cycles, including functional, integration, regression, accessibility, and release testing.
Ensure delivery quality through risk-based testing and release readiness assessments along with the QA CL’s.
 Manual Testing 
Collaborate closely with developers during story development and perform continuous testing throughout the sprint.
Execute functional, exploratory, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for mobile applications.
Validate mobile applications across various devices, operating systems, and screen resolutions.
Identify, analyze, document, and track defects through to resolution.
Support Sprint Reviews, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production release validations.
 Test Automation 
Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites using Java-based Quantum Framework integrated with Perfecto .
Enhance automation coverage for mobile applications across both iOS and Android platforms .
Develop automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing scenarios.
Ensure automation scripts are maintainable, reusable, scalable, and aligned with engineering standards.
Work closely with development teams to automate acceptance criteria and critical business workflows.
Improve automation stability, reliability, and execution efficiency.
Contribute to the modernization and enhancement of the existing automation framework.
Evaluate and implement improvements to automation architecture, test execution strategy, reporting, and maintainability.
Drive adoption of QA best practices, shift-left testing, and quality engineering principles.
Support integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows.
Collaborate with Engineering teams to identify opportunities for testability improvements.
 Accessibility Testing 
Ensure mobile applications comply with accessibility standards and best practices.
Perform accessibility testing across iOS and Android platforms.
Validate accessibility requirements for users relying on assistive technologies.
Promote accessibility awareness and quality standards within the squad.
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience 
10+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance.
Strong hands-on experience in both manual and automated testing of mobile applications.
Proven experience testing native and/or hybrid applications on iOS and Android.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery teams.
Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or other highly regulated environments is advantageous.
 Technical Skills 
Strong knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Advanced automation experience using:
Java
Quantum Framework or Selenium
Hands-on experience in:
Functional Testing
Integration Testing
Regression Testing
End-to-End Testing
Exploratory Testing
Accessibility Testing
Experience with Jira / Xrail / Test Management tools for:
Test Execution
Defect Management
Test Reporting
Experience using:
GitHub
GitHub Actions / GitHub Runners
CI/CD Pipelines
Strong understanding of mobile testing concepts and mobile application architectures.
Knowledge of API testing and backend validation is considered a plus.
